name: wide
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for RiftMon monster battles, wide landscape 1536x1024. Create a beautiful ominous tropical jungle clearing consistent with polished 2D pixel-art handheld monster RPG environments: crisp restrained pixel clusters, readable shapes, hand-placed-looking texture, deep emerald canopy, ancient massive trunks and hanging vines at edges, a few shafts of muted light, dark distant forest, earthy mossy clearing. Perspective is low side-view battle stage, not overhead. The large central and lower clearing must remain calm and uncluttered for animated combatants and interface. Enemy stands toward upper-right of clearing, player's back sprite occupies bottom-left. NO characters, monsters, text, UI, circles, platforms, rings, disks, sparkle suns, or painted selection markers: the engine draws the enemy platform separately. No visible blue sky, no photorealistic textures, no excessive microdetail or bloom. Preserve strong silhouette readability on mobile portrait crops.

name: mobile
prompt: Use case: style-transfer.
